newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINANCE MINISTRY TENDER AVE YIELD 31.34 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINANCE MINISTRY TENDER AVE YIELD 31.34 PCT.

text.p: Average yield in the Czech National Bank's (CNB) "sell and buy" tender for the Finance Ministry hit 31.34 percent, the CNB said on Monday.
The CNB added in a statement that all bids in the American- style tender at the maximum rate of 36 percent were accepted.
The CNB did not reveal the amount on offer in the tender, nor did it say how many bids it received.
Local money market dealers said the tender was similar to a central bank reverse repo tender, but was not used to drain market liquidity.

Instead, they said, it was most being used to provide the Finance Ministry with funds to help it overcome its current cash problems which have caused the government to delay by several days the payment of some public sector wages.
The ministry has been strapped for cash in recent days due to what it says are problems in Czech legislation which limit its short-term borrowing capabilities to 16 billion crowns.
The local daily Malda Fronta Dnes reported on Monday that Finance Minister Ivan Pilip was prepared to borrow from the CNB beyond the limit to meet government payment commitments.
Finance ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
